obligations.summary: Providers must affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 48 upon finding of non-compliance by a market surveillance authority.
Providers must draw up the EU declaration of conformity correctly in accordance with Article 47 upon finding of non-compliance by a market surveillance authority.
Providers must register the high-risk AI system in the EU database as referred to in Article 71 upon finding of non-compliance by a market surveillance authority.
Providers must appoint an authorised representative where applicable upon finding of non-compliance by a market surveillance authority.
exceptions: Obligation applies only where an authorised representative is required

obligations.summary: Providers must make technical documentation available upon finding of non-compliance by a market surveillance authority.

Providers must put an end to persisting formal non-compliance within the period prescribed by the market surveillance authority or face restriction, prohibition, recall, or withdrawal of the high-risk AI system from the market.
exceptions: Market surveillance authority measures (restriction, prohibition, recall, or withdrawal) apply only where non-compliance from paragraph 1 persists after the prescribed remediation period
